The series shows strong seasonality and unstable ranking; a robust non‑linear aggregation like median may capture diverse errors better than weighted means.
Try a trimmed mean to reduce impact of outlier models in a highly seasonal, stable series with unstable ranking.
Ranking is unstable and several correlated groups exist; a forward‑selection weight may capture complementary models better than a simple inverse error.
pool4 contains top correlated models, inverse_error may improve stability
test a simple mean of all 19 models to see if a naive average beats the weighted forward selection in this highly seasonal, unstable ranking series.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality, so a robust DBA on the full pool may outperform weighted methods that rely on error estimates.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 10 backtested attempts, score 0.9691. Series context: trend strength 0.7508 and seasonal strength 0.8188; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.029); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 3.33.
